reference.pathophysiology: Bruch membrane ageing traps lipofuscin into drusen while VEGF sprouts choroidal vessels through cracks, leaking and bleeding beneath fovea; vitreous traction avulses foveal Muller plugs into holes and glial membranes wrinkle inner surface.
